builds.shortEffectLine: Gain this Age's tier yield in Growth.
builds.rulesText: Create a Growth structure in the chosen lane. Its tier and base yield equal the resolving Age; RIVER adds +1 Growth. It yields starting this turn and never upgrades.
builds.balanceRationale: Baseline Growth investment used to measure payback and late-BUILD usefulness.

builds.shortEffectLine: Gain this Age's tier yield in Insight.
builds.rulesText: Create an Insight structure in the chosen lane. Its tier and base yield equal the resolving Age. It yields starting this turn and never upgrades; RIVER does not add Insight.
builds.balanceRationale: Creates the central Growth-versus-Insight investment decision.

builds.rulesText: Create a Growth structure in the chosen lane. Its tier and base yield equal the resolving Age. If that lane is RIVER, the locked RIVER rule adds +1 Growth. It never upgrades.
builds.balanceRationale: Duplicates the legal Growth baseline intentionally to increase measurement of the locked RIVER interaction.

builds.rulesText: Create a Growth structure of the resolving Age in the chosen lane. During combat before the damage lookup, add 1 to the owner's effective lane Power there. The structure retains its original tier and yield.
builds.balanceRationale: Minimal deterministic structure modifier for effect-order and lane-scope tests.

trains.rulesText: Train one SWORD with base Power 10 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 10 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one HORSE with base Power 10 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 10, 100 HP, and REACH in the chosen lane.
trains.balanceRationale: Age I REACH coverage without a fourth combat class.

trains.rulesText: Train one SWORD with base Power 12 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 12 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one HORSE with base Power 12 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SWORD with base Power 12, 100 HP, and REACH in the chosen lane.
trains.balanceRationale: Age II REACH coverage without a fourth combat class.

trains.rulesText: Train one SWORD with base Power 14 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 14 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one HORSE with base Power 14 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one HORSE with base Power 14, 100 HP, and REACH in the chosen lane.
trains.balanceRationale: Age III REACH coverage without a fourth combat class.

trains.rulesText: Train one SWORD with base Power 17 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 17 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one HORSE with base Power 17 and 100 HP in the chosen lane.
Train one SPEAR with base Power 17, 100 HP, and REACH in the chosen lane.
trains.balanceRationale: Age IV REACH coverage without a fourth combat class.

perks.rulesText: During the owner's income step, add 1 Growth.
perks.balanceRationale: Small repeatable economic baseline.

perks.rulesText: During the owner's income step, add 1 Insight.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests reinvestment into ADVANCE.

perks.rulesText: After all Growth-income ADD effects, multiply the owner's Growth income by 2, then apply its defined rounding.
perks.balanceRationale: Required multiplicative economy stacking test.

perks.rulesText: After all Insight-income ADD effects, multiply the owner's Insight income by 2, then apply its defined rounding.
perks.balanceRationale: Required multiplicative Insight stacking test.

perks.shortEffectLine: Gain +1 Growth from your RIVER lane.
perks.rulesText: During income, add 1 Growth if the owner has at least one structure in the RIVER lane.
perks.balanceRationale: Exercises lane-scoped economic effects.

perks.shortEffectLine: Gain +1 Growth and +1 Insight each turn.
perks.rulesText: During the owner's income step, add 1 Growth and add 1 Insight.
perks.balanceRationale: High-value simple dual-resource benchmark.

perks.rulesText: Before combat, add 2 effective Power to each participating SWORD contribution owned by this side.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests class specialization and counter interaction.

perks.rulesText: Before combat, add 2 effective Power to each participating SPEAR contribution owned by this side.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests class specialization and counter interaction.

perks.rulesText: Before combat, add 2 effective Power to each participating HORSE contribution owned by this side.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests class specialization and counter interaction.

perks.shortEffectLine: Your participating REACH units have +2 Power.
perks.rulesText: Before combat, add 2 effective Power to each participating unit with REACH owned by this side.
perks.balanceRationale: Exercises REACH contribution without changing protection.

perks.rulesText: Before combat in the HIGHLAND lane, add 2 to the owner's effective lane Power.
perks.balanceRationale: Exercises additive interaction with the locked defender bonus.

perks.rulesText: After all effective-Power ADD effects, multiply the owner's effective lane Power by 1.10 before counter and damage resolution.
perks.balanceRationale: Required multiplicative military stacking test.

perks.rulesText: Before combat in the COAST lane, add 2 to the owner's effective lane Power.
perks.balanceRationale: Rewards the lane that reaches contention sooner without changing movement rules.

perks.rulesText: During income, add 1 Growth for each contested tile the owner exclusively held at the end of the previous turn.
perks.balanceRationale: Turns early board tempo into economy using an existing faucet.

perks.rulesText: During income, add 1 Insight for each contested tile the owner exclusively held at the end of the previous turn.
perks.balanceRationale: Turns early board tempo into future perk access.

perks.rulesText: Before combat, add 1 effective lane Power where the owner exclusively held tile 3 at the end of the previous turn.
perks.balanceRationale: Small persistence reward tied to the established holder state.

perks.shortEffectLine: Your lanes have +3 Power in Age IV.
perks.rulesText: Before combat in Age IV, add 3 to each of the owner's participating lane-power totals.
perks.balanceRationale: Late-game tempo benchmark against TRAIN-heavy offer weights.

perks.rulesText: During income, subtract 1 from Insight income and add 2 to Growth income; this may not make authoritative Insight negative.
perks.balanceRationale: Simple recurring conversion that tests resource-floor legality.

perks.rulesText: During income, subtract 2 from Growth income and add 1 to Insight income; this may not make authoritative Growth negative.
perks.balanceRationale: Mirror conversion for Growth-versus-Insight testing.

perks.rulesText: If the owner has a structure in RIVER, subtract 1 Growth income and add 1 Insight income during income; resources may not become negative.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests conversion plus lane qualification.

perks.shortEffectLine: Held tiles trade 1 Insight for 1 Growth.
perks.rulesText: For each previously held contested tile, subtract 1 Insight yield and add 1 Growth yield during income; resources may not become negative.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests conversion on the existing contested-tile faucet.

perks.rulesText: Before combat in the RIVER lane, add 1 to the owner's effective lane Power.
perks.balanceRationale: Low-intensity lane-control option.

perks.shortEffectLine: Gain +1 Growth from your COAST lane.
perks.rulesText: During income, add 1 Growth if the owner has at least one structure in the COAST lane.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests COAST as an economic placement consideration.

perks.shortEffectLine: Gain +1 Insight from your HIGHLAND lane.
perks.rulesText: During income, add 1 Insight if the owner has at least one structure in the HIGHLAND lane.
perks.balanceRationale: Tests HIGHLAND as a non-combat placement consideration.

keystones.rulesText: After ADD effects, multiply both Growth and Insight income from each previously held contested tile by 2.
keystones.balanceRationale: Direct prototype of the Master Reference Keystone example.

keystones.rulesText: After ADD effects, multiply the owner's Growth income from structures by 2, then apply the defined income rounding.
keystones.balanceRationale: Strong BUILD payoff for measuring late-BUILD usefulness.

keystones.rulesText: After ADD effects, multiply the owner's Insight income from structures by 2, then apply the defined income rounding.
keystones.balanceRationale: Strong alternative engine for Growth-versus-Insight testing.

keystones.rulesText: After all effective-Power ADD effects, multiply the owner's participating lane Power by 1.20 before counter and damage resolution.
keystones.balanceRationale: Strong combat Keystone for comparison with economic engines.
